$comment: Fault code -> triage routing table. This is the connective tissue of the portal: a code decides whether the operator self-services, schedules planned work, or triggers an immediate dispatch.

self.label: Operator-serviceable
self.action: Follow the linked procedure. No ticket required.

schedule.label: Schedule maintenance
schedule.action: Equipment may stay in service under the stated limits. Book planned work.

dispatch.label: Immediate dispatch
dispatch.action: Take the unit out of service now and request a field technician.

codes.title: Supply voltage low
codes.meaning: Input voltage has dropped below 21.5 V for more than 60 s.
codes.remedy: Check the supply connection and battery state. Re-seat the power connector at the controller.

codes.title: Controller power fault
codes.meaning: Internal rail out of tolerance. The controller will not command leg motion.
codes.remedy: Do not bypass. The controller is not field-repairable.

codes.title: Hydraulic pressure drift
codes.meaning: Holding pressure fell more than 8% over a 30-minute hold on one or more legs.
codes.remedy: Usually a seal nearing end of life. Safe to operate below 80% rated load until serviced.

codes.title: Hydraulic pressure loss
codes.meaning: A leg lost more than 25% of holding pressure, or pressure could not be established on extend.
codes.remedy: Lower the platform to transport height if it can be done safely, then clear the area.

codes.title: Visible hydraulic leak
codes.remedy: Any weeping at the rod seal under load is a replacement trigger, not a top-up.

codes.title: Leg position disagreement
codes.meaning: Commanded and reported positions differ by 4-10 mm on one leg.
codes.remedy: Run a levelling calibration. If the code returns within 10 cycles, escalate to scheduled maintenance.

codes.title: Position transducer failure
codes.meaning: No valid signal from a leg position sensor. The controller inhibits motion on all legs.
codes.remedy: Sensor is replaceable in the field on LEG-A3 only. On LEG-A2/A2H the whole assembly is exchanged.

codes.title: Leg over-travel
codes.meaning: A leg exceeded its mechanical stroke limit.
codes.remedy: Assume cylinder and end-cap damage. The assembly is replaced, not adjusted.

codes.title: Structural fault on leg
codes.meaning: Operator-reported crack, bend, or joint play.
codes.remedy: Do not load the platform. Request dispatch with a replacement assembly.

codes.title: Leg bus intermittent
codes.meaning: CRC errors on the leg communication bus above threshold.
codes.remedy: Usually connector corrosion. Inspect and re-seat leg connectors; book service if it persists.

codes.title: Leg bus loss
codes.meaning: A leg node stopped responding entirely.
codes.remedy: Motion is inhibited by design. Do not attempt manual override.

codes.title: Uplink unavailable
codes.meaning: The controller cannot reach the update service. Local operation is unaffected.
codes.remedy: Check network or cellular coverage. Updates resume automatically.

codes.title: Hydraulic fluid temperature high
codes.meaning: Fluid above 78 degC. Cycle rate is automatically reduced.
codes.remedy: Pause cycling and allow cooling. Check for a restricted return line if it recurs in mild ambient.

codes.title: Thermal shutdown
codes.meaning: Fluid above 92 degC. The controller has stopped all motion.
codes.remedy: Repeated thermal shutdown indicates a pump or relief-valve fault, not an ambient problem.

codes.title: Service interval due
codes.meaning: 500 operating hours or 12 months since the last recorded service.
codes.remedy: Book planned maintenance. The code clears when a technician closes the service record.
